content.comment_body: Hello [product_name] users, Here is an example showing how to log when your [product_name] enters RUN mode using data logging. Description: The initialization flag (M8) is extended for 5 seconds, and using negative edge detection, this event is captured via the data logging function. The math function block output (always 1) is used as sample data. This method works for data logging to both internal memory and an SD-Card. Remember to set the correct date and time beforehand. Hope this proves useful.

analysis.insight_summary: A user demonstrates a method to record when a [product_name] transitions to RUN mode, utilizing data logging triggered by an extended flag. The process supports logging to either internal memory or SD-Card, but relies on proper date and time configuration. The guide is concise, aiming to assist others in achieving dependable state recording for diagnostics or monitoring.
analysis.user_expectations: The user looks for a simple, dependable solution to automatically document when the [product_name] switches to RUN mode, with support for logging to both internal and SD-Card storage options.
